policy: Training feeds, demonstrations and rallies are all possible. No expected repetition count. Screen direction and anatomical side are separate. A rising shuttle alone does not establish a deep lift, clear or final landing.

terms.label: approach
terms.definition: Observable travel toward an interception position; describe actual foot placement when possible.

terms.label: chasse
terms.definition: Leading foot advances, trailing foot visibly closes toward it, and leading foot opens again without crossing. Require the foot sequence; otherwise approach.

terms.label: lunge
terms.definition: A reaching step with visibly loaded lead leg and lowered centre of mass. Do not label any wide stance a lunge.

terms.label: hand_feed
terms.definition: Visible bare-hand shuttle release or a clearly identified cropped delivery. Raised arm alone does not establish racket contact.

terms.label: racket_feed
terms.definition: A visibly racket-delivered shuttle in a supported drill context; if context is unclear describe the stroke without assuming a feed.

terms.label: upward_return
terms.definition: Low racket action plus observable outgoing upward shuttle trajectory. Contact may remain bracketed/unknown; do not infer landing depth.

terms.label: lift
terms.definition: A low forecourt return with evidence supporting a high/deep outgoing trajectory. When forecourt/depth cues are absent use upward_return.

terms.label: overhead_stroke
terms.definition: Racket action and preparation above the head. Distinguish from a low underarm return.

terms.label: smash
terms.definition: Overhead striking mechanics and an observable steep downward outgoing path; an energetic swing alone is insufficient.

terms.label: recovery
terms.definition: Visible repositioning from a completed stroke/reach toward a ready position; stop when motion settles.
